_note: A side of an equity disposal whose STT no breakdown records is chargeable to securities transaction tax when the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004, s.98 Table says so (D-298). Sl. 1: "Purchase of an equity share in a company, where— (a) the transaction of such purchase is entered into in a recognised stock exchange; and (b) the contract for the purchase of such share is settled by the actual delivery or transfer of such share" — payable by the Purchaser. "Recognised stock exchange" is SCRA 1956 s.2(f) (s.97(10)); the recognised exchanges listed are NSE and BSE, permanent on SEBI's list, accepted for both years (D-297); any other string, or none, matches no row and the side stays UNKNOWN. Chapter VII does not apply under s.113A (the NPS Trust; an IFSC exchange with foreign-currency consideration) — no IFSC exchange is on the list (D-298 C2). The same text both years: Sl. 1–3 unamended 2013–2026, and S2 s.196(1)(b) still cites Chapter VII. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-20-securities-transaction-tax.md rows 1a–1g, 2–8; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-20-recognised-exchanges.md.
